title: MobStacker Lite
description: Lag-cut mob stacking with merge-on-spawn and visible stack sizes.
body:
# MobStacker Lite

Overview
MobStacker Lite reduces entity counts by merging nearby hostile mobs into clean stacks.

Highlights
- Merges nearby hostile mobs with configurable radius and max stack.
- Optional merge-on-spawn for aggressive count control.
- Visible stack name display and simple, stable logic.
- Built for performance-focused servers.

Commands
- /mobstacker [status|reload]

Permissions
- mobstackerlite.use

Config
- merge-interval-ticks, merge-radius, max-stack
- merge-on-spawn, ignore-named, show-name

Tags
mobstacker, performance, lag, farms, optimization, utility

Compatibility
Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
Game versions: 1.16.5 - 1.21.1
